subject: storytime
title: Knuffle Bunny words
about: Trixie goes to the laundromat with her daddy, and on the walk home she realises her stuffed bunny was left behind, but she is too little to say so in words. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, looking at the photo backgrounds behind the drawings.

book.author: Mo Willems
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A toddler, a lost toy and a race back to the laundromat before bedtime.

passage.text:
Knuffle Trixie daddy mommy
bunny wash soap bag
park block street walk
lost found upset happy
home run

cards.note: capital K, it is his name; say the k and then the n: Kuh-nuff-ul; ff is one f; le says ul
capital T, it is her name; x says ks; ie says ee: Trix-ee
dd is one d; y at the end says ee: dad-ee
mm is one m; y at the end says ee: mom-ee
nn is one n; y at the end says ee: bun-ee
a says o after w; sh is one part: wosh
oa says long o, like in boat
ar says ar, like in car
b-l blend; ck is one sound
s-t-r blend; ee says long e
a says aw and the l is quiet: wawk
all regular; s-t at the end
ou says ow, like in out; n-d at the end
pp is one p; y at the end says ee: hap-ee
magic e makes o say its name
